author: Claude H-SU (0600 relaunch)
question: end-to-end token cost of the SFU path R23 (LG_PATH 24, accepted sfucore homes) vs R11 (LG_PATH 12), using RTL-measured edge deltas instead of the 2*dLG model

rtl_measurement.evidence: claude/hnetlist-0030 commit 2682006f5 results/rtl/hbm_sfu_scheduled_cost_1016/comparison.json (canonical 3072-word GLU invocation, actual sources + 13x48 relays, 384 macro commits, gold + mutants)

record_shape_check: qwen_compiler SFU.GLU record = g.ff = 12288/TP4 = 3072 words = exactly one canonical invocation; one record per layer (36 per token)
method: tools/throughput/accepted_cost.py hbm_schedule('qwen') + hbm_loss(op='SFU.GLU', delta=d): S2 schedule of the exact per-die program; stream edges counted 1:1 as schedule cycles (conservative: a 1.2 GHz edge is 0.75 of a 900 MHz cycle)
operative_choice: the dependent down MATVEC reads ACT from VM after the last mapped bank commit (+36); the core ack (+48) only gates the next SFU record, which is the next layer (far off the critical path), so +48 is an upper bound
verdict: R23 stays accepted: +0.116 % qwen_ar (bound +0.155 %), 0 % DeepSeek; far under the 5 %/unit ledger limit; no ledger row. Supersedes the 2*dLG model figure (+0.068 %) in lg_path_cost.json.
